name: watch
description: memory-kit watch: delivers a home's declared inboxes into the session as prompts (idle-safe), and optionally asks an idle, grown session to checkpoint and retire

home.title: Kit home
home.description: The kit home whose memory-kit.conf declares the sources (watch_sources) and the retire step (watch_retire_step). Empty: the directory the session started in.

pollSeconds.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often the sources are drained and the idle check runs. Local file reads only.

retireOnIdle.title: Checkpoint and retire on idle
retireOnIdle.description: Ask an idle session whose context has grown to run its close routine and retire (the home's watch_retire_step). Off until proven in the household.

idleMinutes.title: Idle minutes before the retire ask
idleMinutes.description: Minutes with no prompt, step or tool call before the ask (default 50: before the 1 h prompt-cache expiry).

growthPercent.title: Context growth threshold (%)
growthPercent.description: Context grown since the first human prompt, as a percentage of the window, before the ask. Growth, not size: a heavy startup never counts.
